source.quote: Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels. ... Ready and Retry are static images.

per_criterion.delta: 16x16, static one frame follows brief and mapping; no extra empty margin or stroke recipe.
per_criterion.alternative: Any readable asymmetrical check geometry within the 16x16 static image is admitted.

per_criterion.delta: Requires transparent background without matte, permits intentional subject/backing forms and partial-alpha edges. Historical outside-subject/box/fringe wording was ambiguous, not proof the old candidate was invalid.
per_criterion.alternative: A neutral backing disk with a blue asymmetrical check and transparent exterior/partial-alpha edge remains admitted; an opaque canvas matte does not.
per_criterion.finding: consistent; clarification does not remove required transparency

source.quote: Ready must visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion.

per_criterion.delta: Literal owner motif retained; no exact ratio, stroke, backing, highlight or motif-only restriction. Removed category exclusion wording as separate recipe/diagnostic rather than claiming collective family review.
per_criterion.alternative: A check over a plate or with highlights remains admitted if asymmetrical and visibly conveys completion. A symmetrical X still fails.
per_criterion.finding: consistent; actual family distinction remains scheduled

source.quote: Inspect at 1x and 3x nearest display scale on the actual dark panel.

per_criterion.delta: Readable silhouette is required by same brief line; panel hex is observed consumer value. No numerical contrast, essential-detail or minimum pixel-width rule added.
per_criterion.alternative: A multicolor/partly translucent design is admitted if readable at both declared scales.

source.quote: the existing UI's cool blue accent; a fixed palette is not required.

per_criterion.delta: Preserves required visible blue accent while removing historical dominance condition. No exact hex, palette count, coverage or threshold.
per_criterion.alternative: Blue accent on a mostly neutral plate would risk failing historical dominant-colour condition but is explicitly admitted now. A design with no cool-blue accent still fails.
per_criterion.finding: consistent; consequential dominance discrepancy resolved with same specialist

source.quote: Create coherent pixel-art status assets ... No approved style reference exists yet: propose a representative status sample before expanding the family.

per_criterion.delta: Cluster/edge clarity, accidental-noise and resampling-blur assessment are explicitly expert proposal criteria for this sample. Intentional AA, detached details, backing shapes and partial alpha remain allowed; no universal cleanup recipe.
per_criterion.alternative: An intentional detached highlight/AA edge can pass; accidental isolated noise can motivate expert rejection. A readable stippled treatment is a different expert sample choice, not automatically forbidden by owner.
per_criterion.finding: consistent as scoped expert judgment, not owner mandate or adopted style
